blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Private vehicles will be temporarily allowed to pass through the Edsa Busway from Nepa Q-Mart to Boni Avenue stations starting Monday, November 2, Transportation Sec. Vince Dizon announced. Dizon said the arrangement would be in effect for about two weeks, or until the road resurfacing along the stations is completed as part of Phase 2 of the Edsa rehabilitation.
